breakpoints.note: In the staged reproducing checkout, this return statement dispatches the first callback string `lxc.time.offset.bootpt=\t1.\t` after `parse_line()` splits it at `=` and trims the value to `1.`, sending the malformed key to `set_config_time_offset_boot()` instead of rejecting the line.

First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled config text into the parser callback string. `lxc_iterate_parts` expands to `strtok_r`, so with this witness the first `line` available to `parse_line()` ends at the embedded NUL as `lxc.time.offset.bootpt=\t1.\t`.

For the staged value `1.`, `remaining` is `"."`, so this is the only initialization site and it does not run. The patch fixes the bug by moving `memset(residual, 0, residual_len)` before parsing so every residual buffer starts zeroed.
